A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a methodology to diagnose the knowledge management practices in an organization and have applied this method to an IT company.
the rapid appraisal of knowledge management needs is an effective technique that is well suited to the organizational context of a knowledge management implementation project.
we have shown how to use a simple and inexpensive technique to help an organization to develop its own KM strategy.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the rapid appraisal technique can be a useful way to engage a broad range of organizational participants in a shared experience of sensemaking about their organization's knowledge management processes and priorities.

a rapid appraisal of an organization's KM needs is an excellent way to get middle managers thinking about KM in their organization, to identify strengths and weaknesses, and to identify areas where further work is needed to develop KM capability.
the KM diagnostic process itself is a powerful way to build organizational capability in KM.
